client-engagement-details
Client Engagement Details

In a rapidly evolving world of interactive entertainment, this company positions itself not as a game creator—but as the engine that empowers creators. Think of them as the behind‑the‑scenes partner who enables studios, publishers, and producers to move faster, smarter, and at scale.

Their target clients are game publishers, developers, and producers who have big visions but need help making those visions reliable, viable, and financially efficient. They’re not selling games—they’re selling enablement: future‑proofed operations, leaner infrastructure, richer data, and immersive innovation.

Seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to play a pivotal role in building, customizing, and scaling Backstage (Spotify’s open-source Internal Developer Portal) for enterprise teams. This position focuses on centralizing software cataloging, improving developer experience, and enhancing workflow automation for large-scale technical environments.
The role requires both strong engineering talent and collaborative ability to work seamlessly with platform, infrastructure, and security teams.
A keen eye for detail and clear communication are essential in delivering impactful outcomes across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
ul
li
Infrastructure Automation: Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code to provision and manage cloud resources across multiple environments.
Backstage Development: Design, build, and extend Backstage plugins, integrations, and platform features tailored for enterprise-scale adoption.
Enterprise Integration: Architect solutions and connect Backstage to existing systems (CI/CD, observability, identity, cloud, and documentation platforms).
Developer Experience Enablement: Champion workflow automation, documentation, and self-service capabilities within Backstage to boost engineering productivity.
Customization and Security: Work with stakeholders to customize permissions, implement security and compliance requirements, and scale Backstage across multiple teams and regions.
Observability and Monitoring: Integrate Backstage with monitoring and analytics solutions to provide visibility into software and team performance.
Collaboration: Partner with engineering, SRE, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver enterprise-ready developer portal solutions.
Documentation: Develop clear and actionable documentation, onboarding guides, and plugin usage instructions for technical and non-technical audiences.
Availability: Full-time.

What are your typical clients?

The majority of our clients are venture-backed startups at the growth stage. Usually, at this stage, the company already achieved a product-market fit and is looking to expand rapidly. That’s where we bring the best engineering practices, strong architecture, the latest technologies, and consistent processes to help companies scale.
What is the length of your engagements?
Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years. It allows you to evolve your career with the client company taking on more responsibilities.
What’s your company size?

The Right Balance team is 55+ engineers going to 75+ by the end of the year. The current client size team is 150+ people. The timing is great to be a part of a rapidly growing team making meaningful contributions.
What happens if the engagement is completed?
Most of our engagements are long-term in nature. That said, if the current engagement is ramping down, we’ll present you with more long-term opportunities to transition into.
What are your core values?
Client First: we only win when our clients win. We treat client challenges as our own.
Ownership: we embrace responsibility, taking on challenges, getting them to completion, and enjoying getting things done.
Quality: we’re passionate about achieving quality outcomes by applying meticulous attention to detail.

Our client is an AI-driven competitive intelligence platform built for modern e-commerce brands. They provide real-time visibility into market shifts by tracking hundreds of thousands of brands, retailers, and marketplaces across categories and channels. Their platform delivers insights on pricing, promotions, creative strategy, merchandising, and overall site experience, helping brands make faster and smarter decisions. Backed by experienced ecommerce operators and strong funding, they’re building a category-defining product at the intersection of AI and commerce intelligence.
The Role

Our client is looking for a highly detail-oriented full-stack engineer to join their team with a strong focus on data quality. In this role, you’ll be the go-to expert for ensuring that all 1st party (customer) and 3rd party data they ingest - whether it’s screenshots, emails, Google Ads, or any other data source - is accurate, complete, and reliably collected.
This role will also see you deployed to work directly with data engineers at key customer accounts, helping them strategize on the data they need to solve their business challenges.
Responsibilities

Data Quality Management: Identify gaps or inconsistencies in incoming data. This includes developing robust monitoring processes to detect missing screenshots, incomplete email data, gaps in ad records, and the data quality of our integrations into our customers' infrastructure including Shopify, GA4 and Klaviyo.
Hands-On Problem Solving: Once data issues are identified, you’ll dive into our TypeScript codebase to implement fixes, ensuring that the data pipeline is smooth and robust.

Full-Stack Development: Work as a full-stack engineer, not only troubleshooting data quality issues but also enhancing and maintaining the systems that process our data with a focus on driving data processing cost efficiencies.
Investigative Mindset: Approach problems like a forensics data detective - digging into the “why” behind inconsistencies and leaving no stone unturned until the data is pristine.
AI and Automation: Use AI tools to streamline your workflow, and be comfortable leveraging automation to improve data quality processes.
Proxies and Anti-Bot Expertise: If you have experience dealing with anti-bot mechanisms or using proxies, that’s a huge plus.
Customer Obsessed Mindset: Work closely with our customer success and sales team to prioritize critical data issues impacting both existing and prospective customers.
